extra.message: Flask debug mode is enabled (app.py:239) while the app listens on 0.0.0.0:8000 (app.py:242). On any unhandled exception the Werkzeug debugger exposes an interactive Python console that allows remote code execution once the debugger PIN is guessed or brute-forced; debug mode must never be enabled on a network-exposed deployment.

No form in the application carries a CSRF token and no CSRF protection middleware is used: the login form (templates/login.html:14), the register form (templates/register.html:13), and the POST forms for /evaluate, /lookup, /xml and /sayhi (app.py:134-139, 161-166, 199-206, 225-229). Additionally /logout is a state-changing GET request (app.py:69-73). An attacker can forge state-changing requests (login, registration, expression evaluation, DNS lookup, XML parsing) on behalf of a user whose browser visits an attacker page.

The git-tracked SQLite database test.db (the application database) contains a user table with plaintext, easily guessed credentials such as admin/admin and test/test. Anyone with access to the repository obtains working application credentials, and combined with plaintext password storage the credentials are directly usable on the /login endpoint.
